'''Governor Bursthed's Compound''' was a facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruten]]. It was the located of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] [[Bursthed]]'s manor, [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] barracks, and habitats for the governor's large collection of exotic animals. It was ringed by a [[Power fence/Legends|power fence]].
